answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. KL 0.095 and TV 0.089 are within the fine-tuned ranges (0.081-0.205 and 0.076-0.099). Top-1 agreement 0.910 and sequence agreement 0.469 also fit fine-tuned (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64). The raw-score shift/TV of 9.2 is the strongest signal: it sits in the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) and far above both quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9). Quantized is ruled out because KL is above 0.071 and the ratio is much too high. System-prompted is ruled out because KL is below 0.197 and the ratio is too high. The Token-DiFR gap of 0.469 is above the fine-tuned range (0.10-0.31) and falls in the system-prompted range (0.28-0.52), which keeps some uncertainty.
